body:
Raised from #449 on 2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles). Parent: #449. This follow-up is blocked until the #449 evidence packet is merged and releases its claim; it must preserve and cite the parent packet and must not overlap or rewrite its owned evidence.

Review the exact 228 geoBoundaries CHN ADM2 IDs in the machine scope below, restricted to the #449 Chongqing (33), Guizhou (82), and Sichuan (113 of 158) locations. The retained gbOpen source is `CHN-ADM2-17275852`, declared 2017, ADM2 / County Level, and 2,391 units. It is PDDL v1.0 according to geoBoundaries metadata, but upstream rights and a current authoritative roster/map remain unresolved.

Reproduction in #449 found one-to-one source `shapeID` matches and exact Pinyin source-name matches for all 228 rows. Only 3 Atlas geometries match their source after source coordinates are rounded to four decimals; 225 have fewer vertices. The scoped source has 14,634 vertices and Atlas output 12,905, a reduction of 1,729 vertices. This is a lineage finding, not proof that any geometry is wrong. Exact per-feature identities, status and vertex counts are retained in the #449 packet.

## Acceptance

- Preserve the native 228 IDs, original source bytes, release pins, parent packet evidence and neighboring workers' files.
- Recover or document the exact geometry transformation from the pinned geoBoundaries commit to the Atlas features, including tool/version, source/output hash, precision, clipping/simplification parameters, and per-feature effects. Identify the origin of all 225 vertex reductions or mark each unresolved.
- Obtain the authoritative year-end civil-affairs code roster and adequate authoritative map/boundary evidence for the scoped units at explicit vintages. Verify name, administrative class, current parent, completeness, disconnected components, islands, coastline, neighboring coverage and boundary role individually; record every unavailable source and its consequence.
- Retain lawful source evidence with exact hashes and retrieval dates, or provide actionable restoration instructions and explicit license limits. Do not treat statistical codes, code counts, hierarchy structure or overlap scores as boundary proof.
- Deliver sourced bounded correction or engineering handoffs only where the evidence warrants them. Preserve prior source IDs/history and never alter geometry in this research issue.
- Write only under `data/regional-review/southwest-china-adm2-lineage-449/`. No core geography, production writes, deployment, source imports, regional approval or historical imports. One or two focused PRs; a completed review does not certify the Southwest China branch.
- Reproduce all exact scope and evidence checks and obtain a distinct substantive review tied to the exact PR head.

## Source and restoration leads

- Retained gbOpen files are in #449 under `data/regional-review/regional-review-365cbd6478904888/source/`; hashes and LFS restoration instructions are in its `findings/source-inventory.json`.
- Ministry of Justice hosted Administrative Division Code Management Measures (MCA Order 79): https://www.moj.gov.cn/pub/sfbgw/flfggz/flfggzbmgz/202512/t20251204_528920.html . Articles 5 and 14-16 establish authority and annual publication schedule, not polygon boundaries.
- National Geographical Names Information Database: https://dmfw.mca.gov.cn/XzqhVersionPublish.html . Its current 2025 year-end data could not be fetched during #449 research; repeat from an accessible official route and retain the exact original.
- Chongqing Civil Affairs: https://mzj.cq.gov.cn/zwgk_218/zfxxgkml/tzgg/202601/t20260119_15332641.html . Guizhou Civil Affairs: https://mzt.guizhou.gov.cn/xxgk/xxgkml/zdlyxx1/qhdm_88523/ . Sichuan Civil Affairs (2026-06-30 roster): https://mzt.sc.gov.cn/scmzt/quhuaxinxi/2026/7/24/3e9fade9afb548958c2387ed44b5f29a.shtml . These official endpoints/pages were not retrievable as complete originals during #449 research; exact row evidence and reuse terms remain open.

The 228 exact subject IDs are listed in this block. Treat them as an evidence workload partition, not a new geography partition.
